import datetime
import uuid
import pytest

from streaming.dao import RatingDAO, StatsDAO, TitleDAO, UserDAO, ViewDAO
from streaming.models import Title, User
from streaming.schema import create_schema, drop_schema

KS_DAO = "test_dao_ks"
KS_ACT = "test_act_ks"


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def schema_dao(session):
    create_schema(session, KS_DAO, replication_factor=1)
    yield
    drop_schema(session, KS_DAO)


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def schema_act(session):
    create_schema(session, KS_ACT, replication_factor=1)
    yield
    drop_schema(session, KS_ACT)


def test_title_dao_roundtrip(session, schema_dao):
    dao = TitleDAO(session, KS_DAO)
    tid = uuid.uuid4()
    t = Title(title_id=tid, title="Matrix", kind="movie", release_year=1999, genres={"Sci-Fi"}, synopsis="Hacker", duration_minutes=136, episodes_count=None)
    dao.save(t)
    fetched = dao.get(tid)
    assert fetched is not None
    assert fetched.title == "Matrix"
    assert fetched.genres == {"Sci-Fi"}


def test_user_dao_roundtrip(session, schema_dao):
    dao = UserDAO(session, KS_DAO)
    uid = uuid.uuid4()
    u = User(user_id=uid, email="neo@matrix.com", username="neo", created_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc))
    dao.save(u)
    fetched = dao.get(uid)
    assert fetched is not None
    assert fetched.username == "neo"


def test_list_by_genre(session, schema_dao):
    dao = TitleDAO(session, KS_DAO)
    tid = uuid.uuid4()
    dao.save(Title(title_id=tid, title="Inception", kind="movie", release_year=2010, genres={"Action"}, synopsis=None, duration_minutes=148, episodes_count=None))
    titles = dao.list_by_genre("Action")
    assert any(item["title_id"] == tid for item in titles)


def test_rating_dao_and_stats(session, schema_act):
    r_dao = RatingDAO(session, KS_ACT)
    s_dao = StatsDAO(session, KS_ACT)
    uid = uuid.uuid4()
    tid = uuid.uuid4()

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        r_dao.add(uid, tid, 6)

    r_dao.add(uid, tid, 5, comment="Super", username="alice", title="Film")
    r_dao.add(uuid.uuid4(), tid, 3, comment="Bien", username="bob", title="Film")

    for_title = r_dao.list_for_title(tid)
    assert len(for_title) == 2

    for_user = r_dao.list_for_user(uid)
    assert len(for_user) == 1

    views, sum_r, count_r = s_dao.get(tid)
    assert count_r == 2
    assert sum_r == 8


def test_view_dao_history_and_day(session, schema_act):
    v_dao = ViewDAO(session, KS_ACT)
    uid = uuid.uuid4()
    tid = uuid.uuid4()
    today = datetime.date.today()
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)

    v_dao.record_view(uid, tid, now)
    history = v_dao.history(uid)
    assert len(history) >= 1

    daily = v_dao.views_of_day(today)
    assert daily.get(tid, 0) >= 1


def test_extra_dao_coverage_users(session, schema_dao):
    dao = UserDAO(session, KS_DAO)
    assert dao.get(uuid.uuid4()) is None


def test_extra_dao_coverage_titles(session, schema_dao):
    dao = TitleDAO(session, KS_DAO)
    assert dao.get(uuid.uuid4()) is None

"""DAO des historiques de visionnage et des compteurs de vues (tables Q6, Q7, Q8)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import datetime, date
from typing import Dict, List


class ViewDAO:
    """Accès aux tables d'historique et de statistiques de vues."""

    def __init__(self, session, keyspace: str) -> None:
        self._session = session
        self._ks = keyspace
        # INSERT Q6 : watch_history_by_user
        self._stmt_insert_history = session.prepare(
            f"INSERT INTO {keyspace}.watch_history_by_user "
            "(user_id, watched_at, title_id, title, duration_watched_seconds, completed) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)"
        )
        # UPDATE Q7 : title_stats.view_count
        self._stmt_update_view_count = session.prepare(
            f"UPDATE {keyspace}.title_stats SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE title_id = ?"
        )
        # UPDATE Q8 : daily_views_by_title.view_count
        self._stmt_update_daily_view_count = session.prepare(
            f"UPDATE {keyspace}.daily_views_by_title SET view_count = view_count + 1 "
            "WHERE view_date = ? AND title_id = ?"
        )
        # SELECT Q6 : history per user
        self._stmt_history = session.prepare(
            f"SELECT watched_at, title_id, title, duration_watched_seconds, completed FROM {keyspace}.watch_history_by_user "
            "WHERE user_id = ? LIMIT ?"
        )
        # SELECT Q8 : views per day
        self._stmt_views_of_day = session.prepare(
            f"SELECT title_id, view_count FROM {keyspace}.daily_views_by_title WHERE view_date = ?"
        )

    def record_view(
        self,
        user_id: uuid.UUID,
        title_id: uuid.UUID,
        viewed_at: datetime,
        title: str = "",
        duration_watched_seconds: int = 0,
        completed: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        """Enregistre un visionnage, les détails et incrémente les compteurs."""
        self._session.execute(
            self._stmt_insert_history,
            (user_id, viewed_at, title_id, title, duration_watched_seconds, completed)
        )
        # Counter updates (separate)
        self._session.execute(self._stmt_update_view_count, (title_id,))
        self._session.execute(self._stmt_update_daily_view_count, (viewed_at.date(), title_id))

    def history(self, user_id: uuid.UUID, limit: int = 20) -> List[Dict]:
        """Retourne l'historique de visionnage d'un utilisateur."""
        rows = self._session.execute(self._stmt_history, (user_id, limit))
        return [
            {
                "watched_at": r.watched_at,
                "title_id": r.title_id,
                "title": r.title,
                "duration_watched_seconds": r.duration_watched_seconds,
                "completed": r.completed,
            }
            for r in rows
        ]

    def views_of_day(self, day: date) -> Dict[uuid.UUID, int]:
        """Retourne un dictionnaire title_id -> nombre de vues pour le jour donné."""
        rows = self._session.execute(self._stmt_views_of_day, (day,))
        return {r.title_id: r.view_count for r in rows}
